title: MATLAB Agent Skills Delivery Result v2
description: Versioned result contract for an engineering task. UNKNOWN and UNDETERMINED are legal verdict and field values: they record the absence of a determination, not a schema error. A verdict is never rewritten to satisfy this schema; format and engineering math are checked independently by mas_delivery_check.

verdict.description: PASS/FAIL are decisions; UNDETERMINED/UNKNOWN are legal non-decisions.

fields.description: Declared answer fields. Values may be numbers, strings, booleans or arrays; the grading contract decides how each is compared.

units.description: One unit string per contract field that declares a unit.

budget.description: Recorded usage. Required only when the grading contract declares a budget.

status.description: Runner outcome. ERROR is surfaced as a structured error, never as a verdict.

error.description: Structured runner error; only meaningful when status is ERROR.
